description:
Simple Calculator
Use this simple calculator app without needing to install extra apps on your phone.
You can save the app in the "Saved Messages" chat and create a shortcut in your home
screen to use it as any normal installed app.
name: Calculator

description:
Event-Countdown
With Event Countdown you count down the days until an important event.
Track up to 6 appointments. Share your enthusiasm with all group members
with just one click or simply make them jealous 😜
name: Event Countdown

description:
Appointment planning
With this tool you can make an appointment query with just a few clicks.
This will help you find the most suitable date for your project.
A simple rating makes it easy for you to select an appointment.
name: I got time

description:
Sticky Notes
Use this collaborative memo in groups, to keep all relevant data in a central
place without much scrolling. Or use it in "saved messages" to have your memos
available all over your devices.
name: Shared Memo

description:
Mobile-friendly calendar app
Manage events collaboratively with other chat members.
You can import/export events or invites
name: Calendar

description:
Create & track items jointly
Anyone may create named checklist items and mark them as resolved.
Great for planning a trip, party or shopping.
Lists can be exported and imported.
name: Checklist

description:
Cork board app (Demo)
This is a working example app to create per-participant
lists of items which can be updated and deleted from
the respective creator
name: Corkboard

description:
WYSIWYG editor
An editor that can be used to work collaboratively on shared documents.
The editor offers headlines, lists, block quotes, bold, italics and more.
Texts can be exported and send as .txt files.
name: Editor

description:
Pixel graphics editor
Collaborative editor for 1-bit pixel graphics.
name: Pixel

description:
Simple poll app
One question, several predefined answers for people to vote on.
name: Poll

description:
Table tennis
Play realtime classic "pong" game with one other player.
name: Pong

description:
Webxdc Realtime Check
Demonstrate and debug the realtime-channels feature.
🏓 Shows ping time of each connection between online peers in a graph view
name: Realtime Check

description:
Webxdc test tool
Developer tool. Run this tool to understand which HTML/JS features are available
for developing webxdc apps
name: Test Webxdc

description:
Listen to music together
A music playlist application that allows you to share mp3s and listen to them synced with each other, similar to a real life radio, all peer to peer.
name: Radio Station

description:
Birthday order
You make a wishlist for your birthday, other checkmark the items beyond your sight.
An item marked by one person is disabled for the others, so you (hopefully) don't get the exact same thing twice.
You can attach a link to the item.
name: Birthday order

description:
Join numbers to a 2048 tile
The classic 2048 puzzle game.
Move tiles with the same number together and get a 2048 tile to win.
High scores are shared with the chat members

ZigZag-like arcade game
AmazingTrack is a single player ZigZag-like endless arcade game.
Tap the screen to change the movement direction and try to stay on the track
as long as you can.
name: AmazingTrack

description:
Brick-breaker game
A brick-breaker game inspired on the classic Arkanoid game
name: Arkanoid

description:
Play the wave!
Ride the waveform of your music library while avoiding waves.
Play the provided song or upload your own.
name: Audio Dash

description:
Infinite climber game
Help the egg get back up the tree.
To charge up, tap the screen or hold any key, then release to jump
name: Get Back Up

description:
Reverse-reading game
Challenge your brain in this reverse-reading game!
Your objective is to reach the highest score possible, by reading the reverse-texts
and deciphering them, before the time is up.
Answering a question correctly gives you some extra time. On the other hand, wrong answers
penalize you reducing your remaining time.
Compete with friends in group chats with the in-game scoreboard!
name: Back Read

description:
Two jobs, one life
You juggle two jobs and a whirlwind of daily life tasks.
Each day, you must tackle one work task and one life task simultaneously!
Find your balance and complete all tasks across 4 demanding days to maximize
your score and prove you can handle it all
name: Work-Life Balance

description:
A deep-sea adventure game
As a deep-sea fish (with legs), restore balance to the power grid to bring your city back to life!
Plug the cables into the substations to carry electricity further into the depths.
Will the strange sea creatures help or hinder your quest to restore balance?
The original game was created by Joachim Ford, see https://joachimford.uk/balance-fish
name: Balance Fish

description:
Match 3 or more gems
Inspired by the classic Bejeweled game.
You can compete with other chat members for the top of the scoreboard!
name: Dejeweled

description:
Fast-paced platform game
Black Bird and his gang captured Kitty. Black Cat has only one minute left to save her.
The roof is full of dangers and getting hot. Run till the end and catch Black Bird!
name: Black Cat on a Hot Tin Roof

description:
Break colourful bricks
This is a roguelike twist on the original Breakout formula:
The goal is to catch as many coins as possible during 7 levels.
Coins appear when you break bricks.
They fly around, bounce and roll, and you need to catch them with your paddle.
At the end of the level, you get to pick upgrades.
There are 50+ different upgrades that impact the gameplay in various ways
name: Breakout 71

description:
Connect 4 board game
A clone of the classic Connect Four board game.
A two players board game, the game can be observed by all chat members
name: Connect4

description:
Logic puzzle game
Use your deck of tiles to build a path covering all the lands spreading the good word
while also pillaging some rewards as additions to your deck or sometimes even blessing
you with some powerful abilities
name: Casual Crusade

description:
Classic chess game
Classic chess board game for two players and many observers
name: Chess

description:
Color Lines clone
Clone of the Color Lines (a.k.a. WinLines or WinLinez) game.
You can compete with other chat members for the top of the scoreboard!
name: Color Lines

description:
Color bouncing ball
Make the bouncing ball land in the platforms of the same color
name: Coloron

description:
Pirates cannon fighting game
You're finally fed up with your fleet and their incompetence. Take down all of them and claim your spot at the top. Along the way, you'll discover precious cargo dice that represent your ship's vitality and firepower. You may also encounter friendly merchants, carpenters, and potential crew members.
Be careful not to let your cargo's total value reach the dreaded number: 13, as even rolling that in combat can have unfavorable consequences
name: Coup Ahoo

description:
Flappy Bird clone
Help a little bird to fly avoiding the pipes
name: CrappyBird

description:
Puzzle game
A small logic puzzle game. Touch two or more adjacent blocks
of the same color to make them disappear. If the blocks reach
the top of the screen and there is no more free space for a
new row of blocks to fall, you will lose
name: Crashdown

description:
Make the dog spin
In this simple game you just sping the handle to make
the dog spin. Can be fun for children!
Credits: this is a port of https://www.pigenpalace.com/dogspinner/
by Lu Wilson & Flora Caulton
name: DOG SPINNER

description:
Simple drawing board
A little drawing board, create draws and share them with friends,
🎨 🖌️ unlock your creativity!
name: Draw

description:
P2P File Synchronization
Sync a list of files in chats with friends or with your other
devices. Files are synchronized using real-time Peer-to-Peer
connection with other online devices that have the app open
name: File Sync

description:
Path of the Necromancer
"Forgotten Depths: Path of the Necromancer" is a simplified roguelite,
deck building game where you will craft cards, and customized your deck
to take on the undead and their masters.
If you are in a mobile device, switch to landscape mode to play the game.
This game is a port of the original Forgotten Depths game by
David Brad, licensed under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
name: Forgotten Depths

description:
Spider Solitaire clone
Spider Solitaire clone, a captivating and addictive card game that brings the classic
Spider Solitaire experience to your fingertips.
name: fSpider

description:
Idle game
Gibbonacci is an idle/incremental game about you getting a bunch of monkeys to check numbers
for you to find all that belong to Fibonacci sequence. Why? Only you know the answer to that...
The original game was created by Martin Tale: https://github.com/MartinTale/gibbonacci
name: Gibbonacci

description:
Idle game
Become a Necromancer and feed on death to increase your power.
Remember that a true Necromancer doesn't need much time to reach the
peak of his abilities, understand the nature of death and use it in the most perfect way
name: Idle Necromancer

description:
A pirate puzzle game
The treasure is somewhere on this island. Luckily you have a map.
Still, be careful not to get lost in the jungle
name: Treasure Island

description:
Stealth puzzle game
You are Kleptokitty - whisker-twitching, tail-flicking, diamond-snatching master of meow-heist mischief.
The mansion is full of riches, traps, and clueless guards… but none of them stand a chance against the purrfect crime
name: KleptoKitty

description:
Simple rogue-like game
A simple random room generated rogue-like game where you combine different weapons
with unique attack patterns against enemies.
Prove yourself worthy of being called a knight and see how far you can go!
name: Knight Arena

description:
Real-time conversations
With this app you can have real-time ephemeral threads/discussions inside your
chats, ideal for off-topic discussions without disturbing other members of the group.
See who is online, "typing..." indicators and real-time message delivery,
ideal for fast-paced IRC/Slack-like conversations.
Tips: type /nick command in the input field to change nick,
/topic to change the thread topic
name: Live Chat

description:
Single-player matching game
Enjoy several board types, random game generation, hints, undo movements, track your best times
and more with this classic Mahjong Solitaire game
name: Mahjong

description:
A classic Minesweeper clone
Click on a cell to uncover it, the numbers indicate the number of mines
diagonally and/or adjacent to the number. Don't touch a cell with a
mine or it will blow up!
name: Minesweeper

description:
Musa's Quest
Musa's Quest: A Gift From Faraway. A medieval adventure about the search for an exotic gift.
Works on desktop and mobile, too. Just keep the finger on the screen to explore a scene.
name: Musa's Quest

description:
Tower defense game
You are the Necrotic Commander! An ancient master of death and decay,
with the power to reanimate the dead to do your bidding.
Despite your warnings, the local peasantry seek to dethrone you. Using your dark arts,
destroy their pitiful uprising, and send them to their graves!
name: Necrotic Commander

description:
Logic puzzle game
Kill monsters and absorb their power to become more and more powerful!
But beware, you'll soon discover fire, water or plant monsters, and your attacks will have
to be a little more tactical...
name: Number Knight

description:
Othello board game
A clone of the classic Othello/Reversi board game for two players and many observers.
Can be played in real-time
name: Othello

description:
Collaborative pixel-art editor
Similar to the existing Pixel app but every user will draw using their own color
name: Color Pixel

description:
Rogue-like RPG game
Traditional roguelike dungeon crawler RPG game with pixel-art
graphics and simple interface
name: Arcane Dungeon

description:
The pixelated social network
A server-less private social network,
without dependency in any server, you own it!
Send it in a group to have a private social network with
the group members
name: PixelSocial

description:
The PO-12 pocket operator
If you liked the PO-12 pocket operator by teenage engineering
you will love this lovely little PO-12 emulator
name: PO-12

description:
A monopoly-like card game
Use cards to build power plants strategically and manage power, resources, and pollution wisely.
Can you navigate the crisis and lead the city to survival?
name: Power Crisis

description:
Color Picker Game
Test your brain abilities to think fast and select the correct color
and compete with others for the top of the scoreboard
name: Rainbow

Satisfying monster shooter
Ricochlime is a casual game where you defend yourself against waves
of advancing monsters with your ricocheting projectiles
The game is made with the Flame game engine and Flutter
name: Ricochlime

description:
Flash Player emulator
An open source Flash Player emulator.
Select a .swf file to play it
name: Ruffle

Cast spells by drawing runes
Runekeeper is a turn-based strategy game where you play as a mage defending your lil' tower.
Draw (mouse or touch) symbols seen along the grid to command the Runestone to move.
Use the left half of screen to move up and down.
Use the right half of screen to move left and right.
Passing through a power-up orb will cast a spell when landing.
The power-up color dictates spell type.
The power-up shape dictates the attack pattern.
Defeat as many enemies as possible. Good luck!
name: Runekeeper

description:
Hectic space shooter game
Small hectic space shooter with retro graphics. Touch/Click and drag to move your ship
name: SECTOR 13

description:
Snake clone
Help the snake eat and grow, but be careful not to bite yourself!
name: Snake

description:
Fast-paced platform game
Help Drillo on his mission to destroy the X-Ray Orb by avoiding
the dangerous side effects and gaining power-ups and upgrades along the way
name: Snakes And Ladders

description:
Incremental idle game
Incremental idle game with progress even when the game is closed!
Follow the story of a necromancer who has just lost the great war and is ready to rebuild his
armies and fight again. In the process, he finds his conscience and is changing his life
to become a righteous necromancer.
You will build your willing dead army to attack ever-stronger waves of enemies!
Wisely choose skills and attributes to aid your progress to get all trophies
name: Spirit Dungeons

description:
Stack your way up
Try to place the blocks on top of each other as precisely as possible to build the highest tower!
name: StackUp!

description:
One finger platform game
A sword used to suppress the evil force was stolen, releasing a lot of demons. Find the theft and beat the demons!
Drag to aim and release to jump and slash through enemies
name: Stolen Sword

A psychedelic lane-racer game
A lane-racer where you need to keep a high speed by picking up speed boost power-ups.
Keep as high speed as possible, but do not go above 12. If you do, you will lose speed instead.
Beat the 4 opponents and enjoy the psychedelic visuals and chill music!
name: SUB13

description:
Classic Sudoku puzzle
Solve countless number of Sudoku puzzles and compete
with other chat members for the top of the scoreboard
name: Sudoku

description:
Help Kitty to find Bunny
Journey through dark forests and snowy meadows,
pass through a great waterfall to finally reach the steppes and confront the Lion King!
Clear the game to unlock Super Bunny and then hop with him at increased difficulty
name: Super Bunny

description:
Logic puzzle game
This is a game about building a castle. Magnificent and eternal,
the fortress of the mind will rise — and it begins with a single block.
The original game was written by Mark Vasilkov for js13kGames in 2023
name: Super Castle

description:
Logic puzzle game
Takuzu is a little logic game.
The game concept is also known as Binairo.
name: Takuzu

description:
Strategy fighting game
Inspired by 2048!
The King has sent his forces to hunt you down. As one of the last Knights Templar, it's a battle for survival!
Move across the battlefield, take down enemies, and gather powerful items. But beware - if your total weight reaches 13, every step will cause damage
name: Templar's Final Stand

description:
Fast paced survival game
2133 AD: Artificial Intelligence finally took your job,
worried about not being able to pay rent for your sleep capsule,
you decided to get your hands dirty as a cleaner in a terraforming company,
clearing planets from hostile live forms for a low wage.
How to play: Attacking is automatic, WASD/arrows/touch & drag to move, click/touch/space to use menus & select items
name: Terraformers

description:
Tetris clone
Clone of the classic Tetris game.
Fill horizontal lines to make them disappear and increase your score.
You can compete with other chat members for the top of the scoreboard!
name: Tetris

description:
Create text cards
Create and share stylish text cards, send congratulations in a stunning way, make your message
standout in a noisy group, or any other situation where a boring plain text message is not enough
name: Text Cards

description:
A Rubik's Cube Game
Rubik's Cube classic game. Swipe and drag to interact with the cube
name: The Cube

description:
Fantasy console
TIC-80 is a fantasy computer for making, playing and sharing tiny games.
There are built-in tools for development: code, sprites, maps,
sound editors and the command line, which is enough to create
a mini retro game. At the exit you will get a cartridge file,
which can be stored, shared and played
name: TIC-80

description:
Tic Tac Toe tournament
Play the classic Tic Tac Toe game against other players and also watch their matches
name: Tic Tac Toe

description:
Little farm simulation game
Connect the yurts to the farms!
Tap and drag to place paths and re-orient your yurts.
Playing in landscape mode is highly recommended on mobile.
name: Tiny Yurts

description:
One finger concentrated fun
Help Unlucky, the ninja cat, to climb as high as possible.
Jump by tapping the phone screen or use the space-bar on desktop.
Compete with others for the top of the scoreboard!
name: Triska Reloaded

description:
Whack-A-Mole clone
Action game, click on the ninja to get points
name: Whack-A-Ninja

description:
A daily word puzzle
Humans used to fight monsters, but it turned out befriending them is way more practical.
To befriend a monster you must guess its favorite word (or perhaps the only human word they know)
name: Wonster

description:
Share and track recurring tasks
Useful when sharing a flat, for example.
name: Conviu

description:
Share and split expenses
Great for trips, home expenses and dining out.
name: Divvy Bill

description:
A better list
A collaborative list app for tasks, groceries, and more.
Localized in many languages.
name: BetterList
Crate Diggers

Checkers/Draughts game
English Draughts/American Checkers game for two players and many observers
name: Checkers

description:
Beautiful poll app
Let others vote on your questions!
name: Poll

File sharer
Experimental app that automatically splits files in parts and joins the parts when they are received.
It can be useful when you need to send big files or when there is a maximum file size limit.
name: Sharer

description:
Playground for in-chat-apps
Code, preview and build a webxdc.
name: Webxdc Playground

dclogin:// link generator
Log in to DeltaChat with an existing e-mail.
In official clients, it's possible only on the initial setup, but not when adding a relay.
This app generates a URL + QR code allowing to log in with a classical e-mail account.
name: dclogin:// generator

description:
Color scheme generator
Find color combinations that you can use for your designs and artwork.
name: So Many Colors!

description:
ICE sighting generator
Write down possible ICE sightings and send them to your group chat.
name: Found ICE

description:
A minimalist journal
Log your day, create a private blog for friends, or post occasional updates for everyone.
name: Tiny Moments

description:
Rain background noise
Relax, focus on a task, or go to sleep with this rain soundscape.
name: Rain Soundscape

description:
Realtime offline-first editor
Fork of webxdc-editor that can be used to work collaboratively on shared documents.
If users are online they will see cursor positions and realtime typing.
name: Realtime Editor

description:
River background noise
Relax, focus on a task, or go to sleep with this river soundscape.
name: River Soundscape

description:
Share and split expenses
Track the expenses with your friends and find out how much each person owes.
Great for trips, home expenses, and dining out.
name: Split Bill

Compare time zones
Share and compare time zones with people in your group chat.
name: What Time?

description:
Create & track items jointly
Fork of webxdc checklist that adds visual improvements.
Anyone may create named checklist items and mark them as resolved.
Great for planning a trip, party or shopping.
Lists can be exported and imported.
name: To-do list

description:
Collaborative whiteboard
Hand-drawn whiteboard based on Excalidraw. Draw together with others:
strokes and cursors sync in realtime over peer-to-peer while the app is
open, and the full scene stays in sync for everyone who joins later.
name: Excalidraw

description:
Obsidian inspired editor
Collaborative text editor with basic markdown support. UX is inspired by the editor in Obsidian.
You can also explore the history and restore an old document version.
If users are online they will see each other typing and their cursors.
name: MD-Docs

description:
Collaborative grocery shopping list
Shopping list grouped by location in store, modeled on Apple Reminders' Groceries list.
name: Grocery Board

description:
A wiki for your chat
A port of featherwiki to in-chat mini-app.
Add and edit pages and everyone in the chat will see them.
It will not merge changes made at the same time from different clients.
name: FeatherWiki

description:
Give away your wealth to win!
A competitive game for 2-4 players
name: Fund It!

description:
Guile Hoot Metacircular REPL
A demo of a Scheme interpreter written in Scheme using Guile Hoot.
name: Guile Hoot Metacircular REPL

description:
Organize your grocery shopping
Anyone can add, edit and check shopping list items.
Items can be conveniently sorted.
name: Shopping List

description:
Image Album
Generate image albums to send to other people, instead of of having to send each image one by one.
Also supports compressing them to AVIF format, which is usually much smaller the a similar JPEG.
name: Image Album

description:
Keep butterflies aloft
Fan butterflies to keep them flying while a rotating lotus windmill and
fairies stir up the wind. One player, survive 60 seconds to win.
name: Mirkutin

description:
Poll based on D21 voting methodology
A poll app implementing D21-style plus/minus voting scheme by Karel Janecek for a single-winner choice.
One question, many options. Voters give a limited number of pluses and optionally one minus. Gives better
results than one person one vote.
name: D21 Poll

description:
Render nowhr.xyz links offline
Paste a nowhr.xyz/s#... link to reconstruct Messages, SVG Art,
Events and Drops locally — the whole page lives in the URL fragment.
Includes in-app Message and SVG Art composers.
Store, Forum, Petition and Fundraiser links need a Nostr relay
and show an offline fallback.

description:
Swap Clothes & more
Create routes for a bag to travel from neighbour to neighbour, to collect and give clothes and other stuff to your community.
name: My Swap

description:
Schedule viewer
View conference schedules in pentabarf/frab/pretalx schedule.json format.
Liked sessions are shared with everyone in the chat.
name: Skedz

description:
Quiet offline Bible reader
Read the KJV, Darby Translation, and Berean Standard Bible offline with personal notes, highlights, translation notes, and an optional one-year reading plan.
name: Quiet Bible Reader

description:
Minimal journaling app
Quiet Journal is a private, offline journal for notes, photos, memories, and optional shared journals.
Create text or photo entries, keep personal records, or maintain a journal with others.
Full download and backup options help preserve your data.
name: Quiet Journal

description:
Memory Blocks game
Open source Memory Blocks game as seen in Memory Games and Lumosity.
name: Memory Blocks

description:
A modern shopping list
A modern shopping list app, inspired by the Bring!-app.
It is a sleek, user-friendly tool that lets you manage your grocery list inside the chat you want.
Every member of your chat can add, check or uncheck with one finger and remove by clicking one second.
name: Traero

description:
A simple x86 emulator
X86 emulator that can load 32-bit ISOs and supports TCP/UDP networking using realtime API.
Based on Copy's v86 emulator.
name: v86Emu

description:
Collaborative task management
Multi-peer task and project planner app, forked from Vikunja.
name: Planner

description:
3D multiplayer fishing game
Social hangout game with fishing, progression and character customization.
Still in development, expect bugs.
Inspired by the game "Webfishing".
name: webxdcfishing

description:
Connect to classic PGP mailers
ASC, PGP, VCF? You have no idea what this is about?
Don't worry, then you do not need this tool.
Just connect to your friends as usual, eg. via QR code or invite link
name: .asc to VCard

description:
Send confetti greetings
Send interactive, animated greeting cards to your friends.
Let everyone throw confetti of predefined or custom flavours 🎉
name: Congrats!

description:
Tetris with a twist
Fast paced puzzle game inspired by Tetris
name: Hextris

description:
Pac-Man in 1D
Eat all the dots and beware of the ghosts, you got it.
Compete with other players for the only highscore place - it is 1D also there!
name: Pac-1D

description:
Lovely puzzle game
Join the PACKABUNCHAS, a group of space rangers specialized in packing
and rescuing creatures around the galaxy!
Solve tons of Ubongo- or Pentomino-like puzzles, in five different game modes.
You do not compete with other chat members but work together with them 🚀
name: Packabunchas

description:
Tower building game
A little tower building game, you can compete with friends 💒🏢🏬🏦🏯🏰
name: Tower Builder

description:
Realtime Chat
High speed file transfer and low latency messaging.
Both sender and receiver need to open the app to transfer files.
If not, messages and image previews will be sent through the regular updates and files won't be sent.
name: Realtime Chat

description:
Decker Multimedia Platform
Decker is a multimedia platform for creating and sharing interactive
documents, with sound, images, hypertext, and scripted behavior. Decker
builds on the legacy of HyperCard and the visual aesthetic of classic MacOS.
name: Decker

description:
Time-Based One-Time Passwords
A tool for keeping track of Time-Based One-Time Passwords for Two Factor Authentication.
Use it in your Saved Messages to sync your tokens between all your devices, or use
it in a group for enabling shared access to accounts.
name: TOTP

description:
Mastodon Archive Reader Lite
With this tool you can explore the contents of a Mastodon
archive file: account data, posts, attachments, etc.
Imported data stay on the device and is not shared among group members.
name: MARL

description:
Your personal 3D Dice Box
Shake or tap to roll d2, d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, d100, fate,
pip, boost, setback, ability, difficulty, challenge or proficiency
(be patient: roll only if the last roll was complete)
name: 3D Dice Box

description:
A 2d platformer
Lead the Wandering Wraith back to its grave by using various power ups.
Try to collect to all red crystals to get the best highscore.
Mobile users steer by the buttons, keyboarders with arrow left, right and up.
name: The Wandering Wraith

description:
Your personal wish list
Users can note their wishes.
Other users can claim a wish or add wishes for someone.
The wisher can not see the claims.
There is intentionally no export possible to leak no information.
name: My Wishlist

description:
Event Planner
A collaborative tool for planning events, allowing users to vote on dates and times.
Fun fact: This app was made mostly by AI 🤖.
name: Event Planner

description:
Time tracker
Track and analyze your project-/work-times easily across multiple devices, become productive 🎯
name: TimeTracking

description:
Create calendar invites
Create `.ics` files for meetings with date, time, location or Jitsi link.
Recipients can download the attached file and add the event to their personal calendar.
name: meet up

description:
The app creates spoiler images in the chat
You can add one or more images with a description and then send the spoiler to the chat.
name: Spoiler App

description:
An excel like spreadsheet editor
An experimental port of the spreadsheet editor IronCalc.
Be aware that simultaneous editing is not reliable yet!.
name: Calc

description:
Multiplayer shooter
A classic multiplayer-focused fast-paced FPS.
name: Quake III Arena

description:
Handy developer tools collection
Collection of handy tools for developers with great UX.
Ported from the original IT-Tools.
On desktop, enlarging the window may be required for best experience.
name: IT-Tools

description:
Console with a collection of tools
A unique web terminal with many interesting features for all user groups.
The first version is provided "as is", some functionality is tied to online functions, but there is little of it.
